title: Design corpus frontmatter schema is implicit — authored by example, not stated
wanted_capability: A stated frontmatter contract for the design/ corpus (and its siblings research/, specs/) — the required fields (title, kind, lifecycle, corpus, topic), the topic=[corpus, <subdir>] convention, and the lifecycle vocabulary (proposed/partial/archived) — written into the corpus map, so an agent authoring a new design doc applies the schema directly instead of reverse-engineering it from sibling docs and list-design-docs.sh.
missing_primitive: stated frontmatter schema section in design/design-corpus.md (and the research/specs corpus maps)
fallback_used: Inferred the schema by reading sibling docs (sed -n '1,20p'), design-corpus.md, and design/list-design-docs.sh, then mirrored an active (proposed/partial) doc's frontmatter.
resolution_note: Frontmatter contract written: docs/corpus-frontmatter-schema.md (chassis, per-corpus field matrix, topic convention, field-by-field rules, per-corpus worked examples, new-doc checklist) + sections added to design-corpus.md/research-corpus.md/specs-corpus.md (commit 6545b58 on beta/blackbox-v2). Lifecycle vocabularies (design proposed/partial/archived; research stub→verified; specs draft→ratified) cited from real docs, with an explicit "observed, not invented" outliers section. Dispatched to a fleet bro (minimax) during the autonomous dogfood loop (thread-c38e005d).
